evidence.uncertaintyRuleOutcome: omit clause because stable-concept sets differ and terminal-abstention improvement is below 10 percentage points

rules.thresholdSelection: Choose the highest candidate that passes synonym-consolidation and polysemy controls while keeping distinct-concept and over-merge controls separate; no brand data participates.
rules.uncertaintyClauseDecision: Retain the clause only if, for every development provider, it reduces entity_ambiguous|uncertain|insufficient_evidence by at least 10 percentage points and the stable-concept set is identical (Jaccard=1). Otherwise omit it.
rules.reviewBlinding: Review packets contain labels, dimensions and support excerpts only; never counts, variants, cells, providers, prevalence or eligibility. Mapping locks before scoring.

heldoutGate.crocs: must yield an eligible profile with at least one stable identity concept
heldoutGate.xiaomi: must preserve multiple distinct stable identities or abstain; must not pass by merging strategically distinct categories
heldoutGate.tuning: any method change after held-out scoring means v4 and replacement held-outs

developmentSources.insta360: development only; may shape v3; never held-out evidence

gate.controls: all four pass through offsets, complete-link clustering, blind mapping and profile eligibility
gate.humanInstrumentCheck: required before freeze; small blinded human-coded set, not calibration
gate.development: uncertainty-clause rule resolves arm; at least one development profile behaves coherently

heldout.xiaomi: must preserve multiple distinct stable identities or abstain; must not pass by merging strategically distinct categories
